notes: §2002:14.8.35.3 GR16: arithmetic-expression-3 that does not evaluate to an integer sets EC-SIZE-ADDRESS, the SET is unsuccessful and identifier-9 is unchanged. Under ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD the amount stays a standard intermediate value (NumericRenderer.LandedAmount) and SetAmount.Land(CobolDec) tests integrality on its own exponent, so 1 + 1/10**20 raises the condition; it used to land at scale 6 and read as 1 (kb/Work PB5619).
